title: Artifact: per-process RNDR/RNDRRS interception for record and replay on Arm
description: Research-side components behind the CSET 2026 paper "Three Months to Flip One Bit: Upstreaming Replay Support for Hardware Entropy on ARM": the Trusted Firmware-A EL3-to-EL2 trap forwarder, the Linux/KVM per-process dispatch patches, the guest monitor module, the rr.soft RNDR/RNDRRS substitution engine, test harnesses, the substrate-survey probe, and the raw demonstration evidence captured on the stock QEMU v11.1.0 release. The platform components (FEAT_RNG_TRAP emulation in QEMU 11.1 and the EL3 handler for QEMU's virt platform in TF-A mainline) are upstream and not part of this archive.
